he.text: Say from אַשְׁרֵי page 1, till כִּי רַבּוּ page 7, after which say the following—

en.text: Say from “Happy are they,” page 2, till “for it is great,” page 7, after which say the following—

editorial_expansion: End at Shomea tefillah (כי רב הוא / for it is great). The English citation and immediately reprinted Selah lanu identify this boundary; the abbreviated Hebrew כי רבו citation is ambiguous and is retained unchanged in the documentary rubric. Do not duplicate the following Selah lanu.
